blurb: 105F offers hot yoga and pilates classes at four Chicago locations with various membership and class pass options. They also organize multi-day yoga and pilates retreats in locations such as Greece, Mexico (Holbox, Casa Om, Xinalani). Classes include Original Hot Yoga (26+2), Inferno Hot Pilates, Vinyasa, Yin Yoga, and meditation. Retreats include accommodations, meals, transfers, and additional activities.
